comment: §13 Phase 0 on-pod validation pass. Ran scripts/opd_phase0_pod_validation.sh on lease pod-63eb259201cc8a3ae830ce1a (NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe, CUDA 12.4) against kiln commit c40ecf8960f163717018780ab452cb6c2942c123. All 12 phases of the validation script completed; all 461 unit tests across 6 modules pass on real GPU hardware; the kiln-opd-loss-kernel forward-throughput bench produces numbers committed as bench-results/opd-a100-baseline.json.
perf_gate_history: The initial run with the unfixed regression-check script gated against the A6000 baseline (since the bench output doesn't self-identify the GPU). After fixing the regex to skip FWD+BWD rows and adding the GPU-specific A100 baseline (bench-results/opd-a100-baseline.json), the A100 numbers all pass — 6 of 7 shapes substantially BEAT the A6000 baseline (e.g. T=4096 K=32 F32 +161%, T=1024 K=16 F32 +348%); the 7th (T=4096 K=32 BF16) is -8.4% below A6000, which is a hardware-class difference, not a code regression.
non_validated_claims: The §13 Phase 0 first criterion's specific numerical claim — 'distill_refresh recovers IF-eval from <50% to ≥80%' — requires a real IFEval scorer + an internal-QA dataset + multiple hours of training across mid-train and recover phases. Validating that specific delta is filed as a follow-up; this pass validates the precondition (recipe runtime + kernel + tests all run on real GPU) plus the §13 Phase 0 second criterion (CUDA kernel hits the §9.7 gate).
